name: AntD conventions
summary: The cross-cutting AntD mechanics every AhaSlides screen obeys — one component library (Ant Design v6), tokens-not-hex, the fixed 4/6/8/12/16 radius scale, white-by-default backgrounds, AI-border-only gradients, the eslint-enforced Button system, shared DataTable and Icon, charts via @ant-design/plots, and WCAG-AA on custom components.
lead: This is the house build ruleset that sits under every other pattern: it keeps the whole product on ONE component library, ONE theme, and ONE token system so the app reads as a single coherent surface instead of a patchwork of libraries and one-off styles. It ships NO new component — it composes the shared primitives (Button, Checkbox, Icon, the DataTable theme) and binds everything to --aha-* tokens. The narrative 'why', the worked examples, and the C1..C8 PASS/FAIL evals live in the aha-design-antd skill and its judge; this artifact carries only what the repo can enforce and traces each rule back by ref.

skillRef.note: The skill is the source of truth for rationale, the token catalog (references/theme-tokens.md), and the full C1..C8 judge criteria. This pattern distils the enforceable subset and links each rule back by ref to a judge criterion (C1..C8) or a section label.

composedOf.use: the AntD Button system — size via the size prop or <XLButtonScope>, never inline height/padding/radius/fontSize; CTA fill is colorPrimary #6a1ebb
a stock AntD control consumed unmodified — inherits root tokens, no per-instance restyling
glyphs come from the shared Icon by name — never an inline <svg>, never a banned icon package; even Ant Design's own icon set is off-limits
every data grid renders through the one shared DataTable (components.Table theme), never a raw AntD <Table> or an HTML <table>
brand interactive / link / focus-ring / CTA fill (#6a1ebb); white text on it clears AA ≈8.3:1 — no separate darker CTA shade
success states (#16c49a) — bind, never hardcode
warning states (#ff7747) — bind, never hardcode
error states / danger CTA (#f5222d) — bind, never hardcode
info states (#9bb3e9) — bind, never hardcode
links — overridden to brand purple #6a1ebb (AntD default blue is replaced)
surface background — white #ffffff by default for cards/panels/modals
the only non-white default — app-shell Layout body (#f5f5f5)
the default 8px radius step (inputs, Select, menus, Modal/Drawer/Popover, Button md) — the only radius currently mirrored to CSS
Plus Jakarta Sans self-hosted; system-ui fallback only — never introduce another typeface
the 14px base font-size (with fontSizeSM 12 / fontSizeLG 16 and the heading ramp) — bind, never magic px
the spacing scale (4/8/16/32/48) — hierarchy and separation come from the gap size, never divider lines
the animated AI-affordance conic-gradient angle — gradient sits on the border only, white fill behind
inverse text on dark surfaces (#fff) — flip colorText to this on any dark fill, never reuse the black-alpha text token
the single root <AppConfigProvider> theme wrapper (ThemeConfig token + components block) mounted once; only <XLButtonScope> may nest
the one sanctioned nested ConfigProvider — 52px hero-CTA height override for the single most-prominent CTA on a screen
the DS V3 inline Alert (8px regular / 4px small) — not a bare AntD Alert; owned by aha-design-feedback
charts render through @ant-design/plots — never recharts/victory/chart.js
text/number field — inherits the shared controlHeight (32px), never grown per-instance
dropdown — inherits the shared controlHeight (32px), never grown per-instance
blocking overlay — keeps its token radius (8px), never a call-site corner override
panel container — 12px radius via components.Card; white surface, no call-site radius override

componentBacklog: composedOf marks the theme/layout pieces this ruleset leans on that the DS does not yet ship as gated artifacts (config-provider, xl-button-scope, aha-alert, plots, input, select, modal, card). Per the charter, a pattern leaning on a missing component is the signal to add it HERE — this pattern surfaces that roadmap.

rules.rule: Build on Ant Design v6 only — never import MUI / Chakra / Radix / Headless UI / Mantine / the React Bootstrap or React Aria wrappers; it is eslint-enforced (AC08_BANNED_PACKAGES) and fails CI.
Render charts through @ant-design/plots — never recharts, victory, or chart.js.
Source every glyph from the shared Icon / @phosphor-icons by name — never AntD's own icon package, Lucide, Heroicons, or FontAwesome, and never an inline <svg>.
Mount the ConfigProvider theme once at the app root (<AppConfigProvider>); the only sanctioned nested provider is <XLButtonScope>. Don't scatter ad-hoc <ConfigProvider>s.
Keep theme/index.ts (the AntD ThemeConfig) and variables.css byte-aligned — change a JS token and you MUST update its matching --aha-* CSS var (and vice-versa).
Consume tokens, never hardcode — read tokens via theme.useToken() in components and the --aha-* vars in CSS; never a literal hex or px.

In a components.<X> override inside theme/index.ts, use a literal or a defined size* token — never token.padding*/token.margin* (those derived keys are undefined there and silently collapse to 0); at call sites always read the fully-derived theme.useToken(), never the raw partial token const. Verify spacing by measuring computed style, not a screenshot.
Colour comes from semantic tokens (colorPrimary #6a1ebb, colorSuccess, colorWarning, colorError, colorInfo, colorLink) — never a raw hex in a component.
The primary/CTA button fill is colorPrimary #6a1ebb — the same brand purple as links and focus; white text on it clears WCAG AA (≈8.3:1), so there is no separate darker CTA shade.

Keep surfaces white by default — colorBgBase/colorBgContainer/colorBgElevated = #ffffff; the only non-white default is colorBgLayout (#f5f5f5). Don't give a card/panel/modal/section/page a coloured, tinted, or gradient background unless the user explicitly asks; when asked, use a brand token, never an arbitrary hex.

Never put a gradient on any background or fill — the single sanctioned gradient is the AI affordance, and it sits on the border only (white fill behind it via the padding-box/border-box technique), driven by the --aha-ai-gradient-* tokens.

Use Plus Jakarta Sans only (self-hosted, latin + vietnamese), set as fontFamily / --aha-fontFamily with system-ui as the final fallback only; size text from the font-size and line-height tokens (fontSize 14 base, fontSizeSM 12, fontSizeLG 16, the heading ramp), never magic px.

Size a Button via the size prop (small/middle/large → 28/36/40px); wrap only the single most-prominent hero CTA per screen in <XLButtonScope> (52px). Never set height/minHeight/padding*/borderRadius/fontSize via inline style on a Button (eslint blocks it), and never add per-feature aha-*-btn classNames — fix the gallery, not the call site.

Lay an icon+label Button out as a centred flex row in the theme layer (.ant-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center }) so the glyph sits on the label's optical centre — fix the systemic baseline offset in the gallery, never at the call site, and don't add a gap unless measured (the library already spaces .anticon + span).

Take every corner radius from the fixed scale 4/6/8/12/16 (borderRadiusXS/SM/default/LG/XL) picked by element, not by eye — off-scale values (14/20/32/44) are drift and collapse to the nearest step; only a true circle (50%) and a capsule pill (999px) are off-scale escapes.
Bind radius to the token (theme.useToken()) or the --aha-* var — never hardcode border-radius:12px or borderRadius:8.

Let AntD components keep their token radius — don't override a Modal/Card/Button corner at the call site; if a component's shape is wrong, fix it at the theme so the token emits the component-standard value.
Custom / non-AntD containers must still pull a radius step from the scale — a bespoke box is the most common source of radius drift, so pick a step deliberately.

Bind to the target component-standard radius (4/6/8/12/16), not the stale token output — the old borderRadiusXS 2 and borderRadiusLG 10 are retired; close the token gaps (add borderRadiusXL 16, retune the drifted tokens, move Modal/Drawer/Popover to default 8) and mirror every step as an --aha-* var.

Create hierarchy and separation from the size of the gap on the --aha-size* scale (4/8/16/32/48), not from lines — never add a <Divider>, <hr>, or a border-top/border-bottom rule to signal a break; add a divider only when the user explicitly asks.

Don't wrap plain content in a card/tinted/bordered box to fence it off — that mis-reads as a selectable object; group with spacing. Component own-edges (a Card/Input border, a Menu rule, a Modal/Drawer header underline) and the DataTable's dividers-only body are exempt from the no-divider rule.
Keep shared control heights — Input/Select/DatePicker inherit the root controlHeight (32px); don't grow them per-instance. Only Button (gallery sizes) and the <XLButtonScope> region override heights.

Render every data grid through the shared DataTable (the components.Table theme — white header, dividers-only, single-arrow sort, canonical filter/freeze) — never drop a raw AntD <Table> with its own bordered/size/rowClassName or an HTML <table>.
Use the Layout tokens as shipped — headerBg #ffffff, bodyBg #f5f5f5; most components inherit the root tokens, so leave them alone unless the theme says otherwise.
Define the keyboard focus ring once (:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6a1ebb; outline-offset: 2px }) and never override it with outline:none.
Don't convey state with colour alone — pair a colour change with a shape or text change so it survives colour-blindness and greyscale.

Own the contrast on every custom / hand-coloured component (stock AntD already clears AA when you leave the tokens alone): hit WCAG AA — 4.5:1 body text, 3:1 for large text (≥18.66px bold / ≥24px) and meaningful non-text (icon glyphs, chart series, input borders, focus rings).

On any dark surface (the dark presenting stage, colorBgSpotlight, --brand-deep-space #1a1a2e), flip text to colorWhite #fff / --brand-white and re-check the ratio — every colorText* token derives from the black-alpha colorTextBase #1a1a2e and lands ~1.2:1 (invisible) on a dark fill; there is no inverse text or fill token, so use a translucent white scrim for a dark-surface chip and flag that the theme needs a proper inverse var.

Don't reuse the layered black-alpha text tokens (colorTextSecondary/Tertiary/Quaternary) on a tinted, brand-coloured, gradient, image, or dark background — they're tuned for white; switch to a token that clears 4.5:1 against that real rendered background (add a solid scrim behind text over busy backgrounds).
Keep disabled and placeholder states perceivable even though they're AA-exempt by spec — don't push faint-on-faint just because the linter won't flag it.

reuseNote: Doc-only cross-cutting pattern — ships no composition wrapper from this repo. Its source of truth is the AhaSlides frontend theme in aha-survey (frontend/src/theme/index.ts ↔ variables.css) and the eslint rules that enforce the library mandate and the Button system; the full token catalog lives in the skill's references/theme-tokens.md. If the shared ConfigProvider theme, XLButtonScope, or AhaAlert graduates into this DS as a gated artifact, add a reuse block and it is gated like a composite.

selfCheck.label: one component library — AntD v6 only, charts via @ant-design/plots, no banned icon package
no hardcoded hex/px — colour, size, radius bound to a token / --aha-* var
backgrounds white by default; the only gradient is an AI border
Button sized via size= / <XLButtonScope>; no inline sizing, no aha-*-btn
separation via spacing tokens, not dividers; WCAG AA on custom components
